systems.country_label: PLANETE 3.0, plateforme nationale de gestion éducative
systems.tiers: not stated; heads of school, teachers, parents, pupils and academic authorities are called on to adopt it

note: Ministry post on the official launch of PLANETE 3 (page undated; published date 2025-10 is a proxy). It says the platform allows real-time follow-up of schools, teachers and learners, but not that schools enter per-learner records, nor what is entered, at which levels or in how many schools. Left unclassified on that ground, so no fact; if the parent reads real-time learner follow-up as emis, the launch is a last12 advancing event.
